mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hypocalcemia while zoledronic acid inhibits osteoclast activity and increases serum calcium; combined use risks severe electrolyte imbalances, acute kidney injury, and compromised bisphosphonate efficacy.
action: Monitor serum calcium, potassium, and renal function closely; consider alternative antihypertensive if bisphosphonate therapy is essential; ensure adequate hydration and maintain potassium supplementation.
